Delivered behavior:
- Native portrait phone preset feed uses two columns of image/name/category cards and compact download actions.
- Existing template simulation, missing-cover illustration, detail, downloads and camera import remain separate.
- Native GridView supplies viewport-based item creation; old full-width preset rows are replaced.
- Category chips filter local and online sources independently. Per-source/filter grid position is restored on return.
- Local detail offers suggested or custom categories, persisted atomically without changing the NCP/hash.
- Each preset has one optional category. Missing/null/empty old data is uncategorized.
- Category contract: reject raw C0/C1/unpaired surrogates, NFC + ECMAScript trim, maximum 24 code points;
  全部 and 未分类 are reserved filter labels. Suggested values do not restrict custom names.
- First download inherits the published category; hash deduplication preserves existing local metadata.
